name: Ventura County, California (unincorporated / VCBC)
residentialCode: 2025 California Residential Code (CRC), Title 24 Part 2.5 (2024 IRC base), as adopted by the 2025 Ventura County Building Code (VCBC Ordinance 4655)
wuiCode: 2025 California Wildland-Urban Interface Code (CWUIC) + Ventura County Fire Protection District Hazardous Fire Area / VCWUIC amendments

climate.frostLineNote: Coastal Ventura: no meaningful frost penetration. CRC/VCBC still require minimum footing embedment of 12 in below undisturbed grade (R403) — that is an embedment floor, not a frost depth.
climate.snowNote: Coastal plain / valley floor: ground snow load treated as 0 psf for this profile (not Sierra case-study). Confirm Table R301.2(1) with AHJ for mountain sites.
climate.windNote: State-typical ASCE 7 Risk Category II ~95–110 mph; Santa Ana / canyon corridors are special wind regions — verify site. Bones CA dataset uses 100 mph statewide typical.
climate.seismicNote: High seismic — SDC D typical for Ventura County population centers; sites nearer mapped faults can be E. VCBC adds hillside seismic provisions for slopes steeper than 1:3.
climate.wuiNote: Hazardous Fire Areas designated as WUI; Chapter 7A / CWUIC + ≥100 ft defensible space (PRC 4291 / VCFD Standard 515).
sources: Ventura County RMA Building Code FAQ

note: Canonical runtime copy is src/eco-jurisdiction-ventura.ts — keep in sync. This JSON is the auditable data artifact (no network).
